General_Description.Text: A large, switchable optical clearing skull window for cerebrovascular imaging. (2018). Evidence category: method. This card preserves the evidence layer's structured statements and their original field labels; it does not add a new literature review or certify benchmark scoring thresholds.

method_context:
formulation: 
  source: S1 B004; Fig1A–B
  S1: Saturated supernatant of urea in 75% v/v ethanol at 25 °C; reported ethanol volume:urea mass approximately 10:3.
  S2: High-concentration SDBS from 0.7 M NaOH and DDBSA, reported solution volume:acid mass 24:5; pH 7.2–8.
  RI: 
    S1: 1.399±0.003
    S2: 1.367±0.005
    interpretation: physical solution indices, not optical clearing performance scores
  storage_context: sealed approximately 25 °C, approximately 2 months if uncontaminated; reported context, not stability validation
optical_window_geometry: 
  source: B006,B012,B026,B040; S2 FigS2
  finding: size/location adjustable, hemispheric or bihemispheric; bilateral maps acquired sequentially left/middle/right then stitched, not simultaneous single-shot acquisition
  holders: H1 hemispheric wide-field; H2 hemispheric microscopy; H3 bihemispheric wide-field
dual_modal_measurement: 
  source: B007–B009; S2 FigS3; original embedded equation thnov08p2696i001.jpg
  LSCI: 632.8 nm He-Ne, 3 mW; temporal speckle contrast for CBF
  HSI: polarized ring LED, LCTF, second CCD; multiple linear regression for SO2
  CNR_equation: abs(mean_C_vessel - mean_C_back) / sqrt(f_vessel * sigma_vessel^2 + f_back * sigma_back^2)
  CNR_definitions: C means speckle contrast, sigma^2 contrast variance, f classified pixel fraction in selected image; vessel denotes blood flow and back background. Not transmittance.
  main_display: white-light vessel maps selected at 550 nm
TPLSM_conditions: 
  source: B010; Fig3/B050
  matched_region: true
  water_separation_film_um: 11±2
  pixels: 
    [1] 1024
    [2] 1024
  pixel_um: 0.78
  dwell_us: 6.1
  power_mW: 
    [1] 20
    [2] 150
  power_schedule: increased linearly top to bottom
  objective: 16x water 0.8 NA
  excitation_nm: 880
  detection_nm: 595±25
  z_step_um: 2
  depth_origin: pia
microglia_imaging: 
  source: Fig7A/B054
  objective: 40x water 1.15 NA
  excitation_nm: 880
  detection_nm: 525±25
  power_mW: 28
  pixel_um: 0.1
  z_step_um: 2
  dwell_us: 1
  projection_below_pia_um: 
    [1] 30
    [2] 70
SHG_conditions: 
  source: S2 FigS4
  objective: 16x water 0.8 NA
  excitation_nm: 890
  detection_nm: 445±40
  power_mW: 55
  pixel_um: 0.2
  projection_um: 
    [1] 0
    [2] 50
  z_step_um: 1
  dwell_us: 1
  mechanism_limit: authors propose hydration/permeability, collagen dissolution/reassembly and lipid extraction; mechanism not fully established and SHG alone does not prove molecular restoration
bead_conditions: 
  source: S2 FigS5
  objective_as_printed: 40x water 0.8 NA
  excitation_nm: 800
  detection_nm: 525±25
  power_mW: 10
  pixel_um: 0.05
  projection_um: 
    [1] 0
    [2] 9.75
  z_step_um: 0.325
  dwell_us: 1
  metric: full widths encompassing half integrated intensity, not ordinary FWHM
statistics: 
  source: B020
  reported_uncertainty: mean±SE unless otherwise stated
  test: one-way ANOVA in SPSS
  limitations: no independent reanalysis; technical repeats and vessel measurements not relabeled animal replication
supplementary_timing: 
  source: S2 FigS1
  samples: initial; S1 2/4/6/8/10 min; S2 1/3/5 min
  interpretation: qualitative time progression, not calibrated kinetic curve
age_controls: 
  source: B023–B025; Fig4
  PBS: slight image improvement at 2/4 months but not 6/8 months
  comparator_limit: removed-skull images include bleeding and lost-vessel artifacts; no equivalence claim
safety_binding: 
  source: B017–B019; Fig7
  delayed_brain: left window versus contralateral control, 3–4 mm window in displayed sections; 100 µm fixed sections
  systemic: 40 mice total, first-three-day exposure, day28 endpoint; per-group n not explicit
